title: Cooking with Omar
subtitle: Dinner at Omar's — would you like…? I'd like…
canDo: I can offer food and drinks: Would you like…?
I can ask politely: I'd like…, please.
I can write about my favorite food.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: "My favorite food" yazısını ödev verin (Copy my text ile gönderilecek).
I like (genel olarak severim) ile I'd like (şimdi istiyorum, kibar) farkı çok önemli: I like coffee ≠ I'd like a coffee.
some teklif ve ricalarda da olumlu kabul edilir: Would you like some tea? (any değil).
Kültür köşesi: Türk ve Arap misafirperverliği ile karşılaştırın; misafire ikram ederken ne denir? ("Buyurun" / "تفضّل" → Here you are / Help yourself.)

sections.title: Grammar: would like
rules: Offer: **Would you like** + something? — Would you like **some** tea?
Ask politely: **I'd like** (= I would like) + something, **please**.
**I like** coffee. = in general ✓ · **I'd like** a coffee. = now, please ✓
In offers and requests, use **some** (not any): Would you like **some** water?

support.tr: Would you like …? kibar bir tekliftir: Would you like some tea? = Biraz çay ister misin? Cevap: Yes, please / No, thank you. I'd like … kibarca bir şey istemektir: I'd like some water, please = Biraz su istiyorum, lütfen. Dikkat: I like coffee (genel olarak kahve severim) ile I'd like a coffee (şimdi bir kahve istiyorum) farklıdır.
support.ar: Would you like …? عرضٌ مؤدّب: Would you like some tea? = هل تودّ بعض الشاي؟ والجواب: Yes, please أو No, thank you. أمّا I'd like … فطلبٌ مؤدّب: I'd like some water, please = أودّ بعض الماء من فضلك. انتبه: I like coffee (أحبّ القهوة عمومًا) تختلف عن I'd like a coffee (أريد قهوة الآن).

tr.note: Şimdi bir şey isterken I like değil I'd like de. Tekliflerde any değil some.

ar.note: لا تقل I want في المطعم أو عند الضيافة؛ I'd like أكثر أدبًا. ولا تنسَ please.
